Workspaces

Workspaces greatly simplify the process of grouping tabs, making it easier to organize and manage your tabs.

Basic Settings
Enable workspace feature

A restart of Floorp is required to completely enable or disable the workspace feature.

Appearance and behavior
How to use
Close workspace popup when selecting a workspace
Choose whether to close the workspace popup when selecting a workspace.
Show workspace name next to the icon
Exit Floorp when last workspace tab is closed
Manage workspaces on Floorp sidebar
When this feature is enabled, you can only manage workspaces on the Floorp sidebar. You won't be able to manage workspaces using the toolbar button.
Reset workspaces

Reset workspace data to its default state. All custom workspaces will be removed and all tabs will be reassigned to the new workspace.
